header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: . Indeed, the religion (Deen) is the name for acting with sincerity and faithfulness,” Rasulullah ﷺ said. The Sahabah (RA) asked, “With whom is one to act with sincerity and faithfulness?” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “With Allah Ta'ala, with the Messenger of Allah Ta'ala, with the Book of Allah Ta'ala, with the rulers of the Muslims, and with the common Muslims.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- Acting with sincerity and faithfulness towards Allah Ta'ala means having Iman in Him, loving Him boundlessly, fearing Him, obeying Him, worshipping Him and not associating partners with Him. Acting with sincerity and faithfulness towards the Book of Allah means having Iman in the Book, fulfilling the duty of honouring it as it deserves, learning the Book, spreading its knowledge and acting according to what one has learned. Acting with sincerity and faithfulness towards the Messenger of Allah means affirming what he said, settling his greatness in the heart, loving him and his way, and believing that success lies in following him with heart and soul. Acting with sincerity and faithfulness towards the Muslim rulers means being a help and support to them in fulfilling their responsibilities, having a good opinion of them, giving them good advice, and obeying them in matters permitted in the religion.
